fields.name: MapToPg*Attribute supported-type matrix
fields.description: The valid MapToPg*Attribute selections and compatible CLR model-property types. Each member names the target PostgreSQL type selected by that variant; nullable forms listed in the description are explicitly accepted.

members.name: Varchar
members.description: MapToPgVarcharAttribute accepts string, enum, or nullable enum; length is required.

members.name: Char
members.description: MapToPgCharAttribute accepts string, enum, or nullable enum; length is required.

members.name: Text
members.description: MapToPgTextAttribute accepts string.

members.name: Bigint
members.description: MapToPgBigintAttribute accepts long, enum, or nullable long.

members.name: Integer
members.description: MapToPgIntegerAttribute accepts int, enum, nullable int, or nullable enum.

members.name: Smallint
members.description: MapToPgSmallintAttribute accepts short, enum, nullable short, or nullable enum.

members.name: InternalChar
members.description: MapToPgInternalCharAttribute accepts byte, enum, nullable byte, or nullable enum.

members.name: Boolean
members.description: MapToPgBooleanAttribute accepts bool or nullable bool.

members.name: Numeric
members.description: MapToPgNumericAttribute accepts decimal or nullable decimal; precision and scale are required.

members.name: Money
members.description: MapToPgMoneyAttribute accepts decimal or nullable decimal.

members.name: Double
members.description: MapToPgDoubleAttribute accepts double or nullable double.

members.name: Real
members.description: MapToPgRealAttribute accepts float or nullable float.

members.name: Timestamp
members.description: MapToPgTimestampAttribute accepts DateTime, DateTimeOffset, nullable DateTime, or nullable DateTimeOffset.

members.name: TimestampTz
members.description: MapToPgTimestampTzAttribute accepts DateTimeOffset or nullable DateTimeOffset.

members.name: Date
members.description: MapToPgDateAttribute accepts DateTime or nullable DateTime.

members.name: Time
members.description: MapToPgTimeAttribute accepts TimeSpan or nullable TimeSpan.

members.name: Interval
members.description: MapToPgIntervalAttribute accepts TimeSpan or nullable TimeSpan.

members.name: TimeTz
members.description: MapToPgTimeTzAttribute accepts TimeSpan, DateTimeOffset, nullable TimeSpan, or nullable DateTimeOffset.

members.name: Array
members.description: MapToPgArrayAttribute accepts an array; its constructor requires the PostgreSQL element type.

members.name: Bytea
members.description: MapToPgByteaAttribute accepts byte[]; length is required.

members.name: Hstore
members.description: MapToPgHstoreAttribute accepts IDictionary<string, string>.

members.name: Uuid
members.description: MapToPgUuidAttribute accepts Guid or nullable Guid.

representations.CSharp: Compatibility is enforced by each public MapToPg*Attribute variant's IsValidType(Type) override; constructors select the corresponding NpgsqlDbType.

sources.label: MapToPg attribute type selections and IsValidType predicates
